help_open_text: Choose File → Open to select a PDF. Enter the opening password if requested. PDFs are processed on your device.
help_edit_text: Click a thumbnail to select a page. Use Ctrl (Command on macOS) or Shift to select multiple pages. Move, rotate, or delete pages using the Edit menu or toolbar. You can also drag pages to reorder them. You cannot delete all pages.
help_insert_text: Choose Edit → Insert PDF to add another PDF. Select a page and choose Insert Same-Size Blank Page After to add a blank page.
help_save_text: Choose Save to write your changes. To keep the original PDF, use Save As to save to a different file. An * in the title indicates unsaved changes.
help_properties_text: Choose File → Document Properties to set the title, author, PDF version, page layout, and binding direction. Selecting TwoPageLeft / TwoPageRight raises the PDF version to 1.5 if needed.
help_password_text: Use the File menu to set or remove the opening password. Save the PDF to apply the change.
help_settings_text: Use the Settings menu to change the language and image size (144 / 288 / 432 px). Language changes take effect after restarting the application. Image size changes take effect immediately.
